notes.title: Labyrinth of The Demon King NG+ Update Launches October 27th
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We're extremely happy to announce that the cycle of life and death continues...and with it comes a much anticipated [b]free content update[/b]. This October 27th at 10am ET, delve back into the ominous labyrinth. This free update does not change the labyrinth you've come to know and love, but rather adds an expansive set of new end-game content for once you've finished the game initially. [/p][p]New weapons, enemies, puzzles, mechanics, interactions, and much more await you. Rise once more, ashigaru. [b]Rise![/b] [/p][p]Check out the official announcement here, featuring a first look at NG+:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OQuqJwIXC_o;full"][/previewyoutube][p]For those who have purchased the game elsewhere on consoles, this patch will be coming alongside the prior patches previously available on PC & GOG.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.21 now live!
notes.content: [p]Hey all, [/p][p]We're pleased to say that the 1.2 patch for Labyrinth of the Demon King is now live on the main branch! This comes following a period of extensive testing, and the prior public access for the update available on a preview branch. [b]For clarity, the preview branch and the main branch are now on the same version.[/b][/p][p]Before we get into the changelog for this version, we'd like to quickly say welcome to all new players of Labyrinth coming in from the Steam Summer Sale, and we appreciate all of the continued support![/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog for version 1.21 (same as prior preview builds):[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed aspect ratio reverting to 4:3 during in-game cutscenes while a wide aspect was selected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed background showing behind item placement menu in 16:9 or 16:10 aspects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Tea making ceremony aspect ratio reverting to 4:3 when 16:9 or 16:10 was selected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed irregularity with Nuppeppo boss fight larva behaviour[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra localisation strings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed textures sticking out in some locations[/p][/*][*][p]Added stash box to tea house[/p][/*][*][p]Added compass item to merchant’s store inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted all maps to be North orientated to match compass[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted code for bleed and other status effects to be framerate independent[/p][/*][*][p]Added safe zone to HUD widget[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted stairs in Nuppeppo boss room and adjusted nav mesh settings[/p][/*][*][p]Changed scroll bar on several widgets to better fit other HUD items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where headshot ranged damage modifier was used for melee weapon headshots[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed kicks being parryable on some weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to toggle HUD[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to toggle crosshair[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to toggle widescreen[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to equip torch instead of lantern if using a 1 handed weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to lower intensity of film grain[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to remove equipped armour[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing teleport cutscene[/p][/*][*][p]Changed how stamina regeneration works[/p][/*][*][p]Made larva bigger and increased it's hitbox size[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Nuribotoke having trouble climbing stairs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where NPC leaving mid conversation would leave the player stuck in dialog[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing in air animations for war axe[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the Jailer would T-Pose during his teaser[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered resolution of controller icons to fit the aesthetic better[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing translation for single slide of kings court puzzle[/p][/*][*][p]Changed conditions for interacting with priest after Tsuchigumo death, hopefully fixing issue where people can't interact with him[/p][/*][*][p]Added changes to receive damage code, hopefully fixing issue where bosses can lose too much health from a single hit[/p][/*][/list][p]If you do encounter any bugs while playing the game, please consider leaving a reply here, or a topic in the Steam forum to let us know - we'll take a look at it! Alternatively, if it feels more natural to you to report bugs via Discord, you can find details on how to join our community below.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy, and if you'd like to discuss more about the game, please feel free to join our Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/yy7javF"]https://discord.gg/yy7javF[/url][/p][p]Thank you for the continued support for Labyrinth of the Demon King, and stay tuned for more cool updates... [/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes (Post-Launch 1.01)
notes.content:
Hi all, as discussed within our initial post-launch update post, a new post-launch patch is now live for Labyrinth of the Demon King. 

Just to reiterate, the changes in this patch are:

[list]
[*] Added framerate cap options (and warning popup that some behaviour may be unpredictable at very high frame rates)
[*] Disabled torch being unequipped when entering an exterior cell
[*] Using the quick equip torch button will now equip the lantern if the player has purchased it
[*] Fixed error where placeholder language names were used instead of official translated terms 
[*] Fixed spelling error in Kings Court Puzzle
[*] Fixed issue where status effects would display “{Amout}” instead of the number for stack amounts for certain languages
[/list]

We hope this improves the experience within the Labyrinth of the Demon King. We're working on other reported issues and are still collecting some initial points of feedback, so stay tuned for more. Thank you for all the support so far!

notes.title: A week after launch, my new favorite gungy, Condemned-style horror-brawler has its first patch and the promise of yokai-punching spiked knuckles on the way
notes.content: Survival horror dungeon crawler Labyrinth of the Demon King is neck-and-neck with Avowed and Oblivion Remastered as my personal game of the year so far, which I absolutely did not expect when I loaded it up on my Steam Deck before a flight (I ended up playing it all five hours). But even more surprising is that its small development team is already promising new additions just a week after launch... Read more.

notes.title: Thank you for the support - Future plans + Upcoming Patches
notes.content:
Hello all, first of all, we'd like to thank everybody for the great reception to Labyrinth of the Demon King. The game has been a labour of love over a long period of time, and we're pleased to see that all the work and refinement that went into the game has really struck a chord with people! We appreciate it a lot.

We've been listening to your feedback points, and have planned a series of patches to improve/address the most commonly mentioned issues. One of these has been heard loud and clear: you would all like to punch small people in the face. Here's a sneak peek at a new weapon that'll allow you to do so, which will be available in a free upcoming update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41573288/a3d87ed71a944f742816b53e970838e02fb97e53.gif[/img]

Before that though, we'll have a smaller hotfix/improvement patch coming within the next few days, which will address a few small points. These are (will be repeated in patch notes): 

[list]
[*] Added framerate cap options (and warning popup that some behaviour may be unpredictable at very high frame rates)
[*] Disabled torch being unequipped when entering an exterior cell
[*] Using the quick equip torch button will now equip the lantern if the player has purchased it
[*] Fixed error where placeholder language names were used instead of official translated terms 
[*] Fixed spelling error in Kings Court Puzzle
[*] Fixed issue where status effects would display “{Amout}” instead of the number for stack amounts for certain languages
[/list]

Other issues are being looked at and will be addressed in future updates/patches.

Once again, thank you all for the support! We are thrilled with the reception the game has received. If you've been enjoying the game, be sure to leave a review as it does help us a lot as a small team. See you all again soon!

notes.title: Thank you for playing Labyrinth's Scream Fest Demo! + Upcoming Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We wanted to give a sincere thank you to everyone who has played Labyrinth's demo during the Scream Fest. The support we've received has been unbelievable, and it's been amazing to see the feedback for the game and how widespread acclaim for it has been. As mentioned, we have removed our demo from Steam for the time being (current players will retain access) - please do not worry though, the demo will return sometime soon! 

In the meantime, the feedback from everyone has been hugely appreciated. Here are some things we are working on addressing, which should rear their heads around for the full release (or the next public demo!):

[list]
[*] Recovery Item Balancing
[*] Stamina/Sprinting Balancing
[*] UI & Visibility Improvements
[*] Hardcore Mode
[*] Sound Design Tweaks/Improvements
[*] Combat Smoothing / AI Tweaks
[*] Collision Fixes
[*] Options Improvements - Vsync, Keybinding, etc.
[/list]

Once thing we'd like to address is we have heard worries from our discord community regarding our desire to make certain improvements to the game based on feedback; so everyone knows, we have no plans to change the core gameplay of course. Our design philosophy is very set in stone; that being said, much of the feedback we received was very valid and missed/overlooked during our testing process - things such as the UI being hard to read at times, or combat being easily cheesed. These are all things which we would like to fix to ensure an optimal experience for everyone. Essentially, our goal is for the next version of the game which everyone plays to simply be an even better version of what you've played already - not an entirely new game as some people may be concerned about.

Once again, we can't thank everyone enough for playing the demo, and supporting the game. We'll have more news soon on the revamped demo as well as our launch window. See you all soon!
